RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.
 

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.
 

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
 
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
 
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
 
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
 
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
 
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
 
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
 
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations. 

 
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
 
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
 
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
 
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
 
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
 
• Good physical fitness.
 
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
 
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.  

 

 

• Proven experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role with a focus on process improvement. 

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

•

•

•

•

• 
Off-site Meetings: Coordinate logistics, including hotels, catering, venues, and registration.

 
• 
Events: Organise Christmas parties and team-building activities.

 
• 
Mailing Lists & Org Charts: Keep mailing groups and organisation charts up to date.

 
• 
Office Management: Coordinate daily office operations, meeting rooms, and group calendars.

 
• 
(Oracle Finance system) PR/PO & Supplier Creation: Create PR/Pos when needed (such as special office supply ordering, Teambuilding down payment)

 
• 
Facilities: Coordinate facility matters, locker lists, and Kara-Kara clean-up activities.

 
• 
Ad-hoc Support: Support team members with ad-hoc requests.

 
• 
One Team Sprit: Support the leadership team in building a One Team Sprit considering the diversity of the divisions.

 
• 
Reliable, Accurate & Proactive: Attention to detail, highly precise, strong organisational skills.

 
• 
Persistent, Stress-resistant & Hard-working: Focused and resilient in a demanding environment.

 
• 
Team Player and Independent Worker: Collaborates well and manages tasks independently.

 
• 
Multicultural Communication: Communicates effectively in diverse environments.

 
• 
Results-driven: Turns objectives into clear, tangible actions.

 
• 
Communication and Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly and professionally.

 
• 
Planning and Organisation: Manages priorities and multiple tasks efficiently.

 
• 
Discreet: Handles confidential information professionally and with high integrity.

 
• 
Microsoft Office Skills: Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams.

 
• 
Fluent in English: Other languages are an asset.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Senior IT Recruiter (Permanent & Freelance Talent Solutions)
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility. Driven by its ambition to grow and industrialize, Inetum generated Sales of EUR2.5 billion in 2023.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At inetum, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job description

 
• We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Recruiter to help us attract and engage top technology talent across Belgium. This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying opportunities and finding solutions in a competitive talent market.
 
• You have a strong network within the IT sector, are comfortable approaching candidates directly, and know how to build credibility with both candidates and business stakeholders. You combine recruitment expertise with a commercial mindset and enjoy working closely with the business to achieve results.
 
• You will play a key role in attracting both permanent employees and freelance consultants, partnering closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to support the continued growth of the business.
 
• As a Senior IT Recruitment Partner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for both permanent and freelance IT positions. You will act as a trusted advisor to the business, bringing market insights, challenging assumptions and helping hiring managers make informed talent decisions.

Key responsibilities

 
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for permanent and freelance IT profiles
 
• Proactively source and engage high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, networking, referrals, events and other sourcing channels
 
• Build, maintain and leverage a strong network within the IT and technology market
 
• Conduct candidate interviews to ensure both technical and cultural fit
 
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process and create an excellent candidate experience
 
• Partner closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to understand hiring needs and business priorities
 
• Challenge and advise stakeholders on talent availability, market realities and recruitment strategies
 
• Develop creative sourcing approaches to identify niche and hard-to-find profiles
 
• Stay informed about technology trends and developments within the talent market
 
• Act as an ambassador for the company and contribute to strengthening our employer brand

Additional information

...

Experience & skills:

• Minimum 5 years of recruitment experience within IT or technology recruitment

• Proven experience recruiting both permanent employees and freelance consultants

• Strong sourcing capabilities with a track record of successfully filling challenging roles

• Well-established network within the IT and technology community

• Commercial mindset and strong relationship-building skills

• Able to influence, challenge and advise stakeholders at different levels of the organisation

• Genuine interest in technology and the IT market

• Resilient and persistent in your approach to recruitment

• Strong communication and negotiation skills

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

• Knowledge of French is an asset
